headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.85
summary: Fixes recurring multi-second in-game freezes and restores the AMOLED theme after exiting a game.

items.text: Recurring ~3s in-game freezes: the Hotbar Slot inbuilt mod no longer installs its native hooks at launch unless the mod is actually enabled (stale signatures on newer Minecraft builds caused freeze loops, see upstream #365).

AMOLED theme: returning to the launcher after a game session no longer falls back to the M3 dark palette; the AMOLED configuration is now scoped to its own Resources instead of the shared AssetManager.
Theme state: removed the global night-mode overrides that fought the selected theme during process start and theme manager construction.
